resources.string: Start is disabled. Find power first.
Power online. Now stop the wobble.
Already plugged in. No extra electricity points.
Anchor is wobbling. Tap it to stabilize.
Try again after fixing the stand.
There is no wheel left to spin.
Overheat! The wheel caught fire and vanished.
New round. Power is unplugged again.

string-array.name: anchor_fall_messages
string-array.item: The anchor fell. Nobody knows the result.
Good, we don\'t know the result now. 🎉
Anchor down. Result: ????? Classic.
Result lost to gravity. Well done.
The anchor disagrees with your life choices.
Oops. The result is now a mystery.

string-array.name: failure_messages
string-array.item: Gerald had one job…
The stand files for early retirement.
This is fine. Everything is fine. 🔥
Have you tried not breaking it?
Error 404: Structural integrity not found.
Instructions unclear. Wheel on fire.
Maybe fix things before pressing buttons.

string-array.name: respawn_messages
string-array.item: Gerald is back. Very reluctantly.
Wheel respawned. Pretend that didn\'t happen.
New wheel, same problems. Fix them.
The wheel is back! The stand is still judging you.
Try again. Gerald believes in you. (He doesn\'t.)
Structurally questionable, but we\'re back.
Wheel respawned. The anchor is still wobbly. Shocking.
